{{Quote|I know you can exploit any advantage, Jedi. So the soldiers had to die. The civilians too. I do, after all, take pride in being thorough.|[[Augin Blaesus]]|<ref name="TOR:TStK" />}}
Around [[3642 BBY]], during the [[Galactic War]], the [[King/Legends|King]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]] wanted to heal the relationship between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Rift Alliance]] by donating a regiment of Sarkhai [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. However, because the Barsen'thor had to take care of a [[Mission to Hoth (Barsen'thor)|problem]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tobas Grell]] sent representative [[Augin Blaesus]] to attend the royal ceremony onboard [[Waypoint Station Three]]. However, after discovering that Blaesus may have been an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] spy, Grell sent the Barsen'thor on a '''mission''' to save the [[Sarkhai royal family]].<ref name="TOR:TStK" />
